DISTRIBUTION, BUILT IN

Give people something useful to share.

Lead with the free checklist. Send anglers to the destination that matches their trip. Track the source—not just the clicks.

01 / YOUR TRACKABLE LINK

Build a campaign link.

02 / OPERATOR INTRODUCTION

A useful first message.

This is a draft for personal outreach—not an automated sending campaign.

Hi [Name] — I’m building Fishing Atlas, a free preparation tool for fishing trips. Your clients can mark what they own, see what you provide, and get a checklist for what’s missing. Would you try a preparation link with a few clients? It can sit alongside your existing booking process. Here’s an example: [your campaign link]
Start with a small set of relevant operators and real feedback. No contacts have been messaged by this app.
03 / SHORT-FORM HOOKS

Show the problem being solved.

Hook A: “You booked the fishing trip. Now what do you actually need to bring?”

Hook B: “Before you buy new fishing gear, check what you own—and what your guide already provides.”

Hook C: “One fishing trip. Too many tabs. Here’s a checklist that starts with your destination.”

Demo: choose the trip → mark owned gear → confirm guide equipment → share the remaining list.

Call to action: “Build your free trip checklist.”

04 / WHAT TO MEASURE

Useful plans before vanity traffic.

The code emits page views, plan updates, checklist changes, share actions, shopping clicks, operator clicks and form results. UTM attribution is retained on this browser.

This release: events are available to a connected analytics adapter and recorded locally for debugging. There is no central analytics account connected yet.

Start with operators and personal trip content. Test paid acquisition only after measuring an actual monetized action—not merely checklist clicks.
